title: airopsis capillaris
intro: Airopsis capillaris, commonly known as Mountain Sage, is a perennial plant species native to the Mediterranean region. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help to soothe digestive issues and protect against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Mountain Sage include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce anxiety and stress, and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of Airopsis capillaris include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and contribute to its potential therapeutic applications.
